title: Program Manager - Technology / IT
jobDescription: As a Technical Program Manager, you will own the complete lifecycle of strategic AI products and platformsfrom product planning and roadmap definition to engineering execution, customer rollout, and continuous improvement. You will work directly with leadership, product teams, engineering managers, AI researchers, customers, and business stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, define execution strategies, monitor product health, and ensure timely delivery of enterprise-grade AI solutions. This role requires someone who is equally comfortable discussing LLM architectures with engineers, business priorities with leadership, and customer requirements with enterprise clients. Product Strategy & Product Management Collaborate with leadership to define product vision, roadmap, and long-term technology strategy. Convert business requirements into well-defined product features and technical deliverables. Own product lifecycle management from ideation to production release. Gather and prioritize customer feedback, market trends, and competitive insights. Define Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, feature specifications, and acceptance criteria. Prioritize product backlog based on business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility. Drive feature planning for AI products, enterprise platforms, and Saa S offerings. Technical Program Management Lead multiple cross-functional technical programs simultaneously. Own execution of complex AI and software engineering initiatives. Define program goals, milestones, dependencies, and release schedules. Coordinate engineering efforts across backend, frontend, AI, infrastructure, Dev Ops, and QA teams. Manage interdependencies between multiple engineering workstreams. Identify execution risks early and proactively drive mitigation plans. Ensure alignment between engineering execution and business objectives. Project Management Develop detailed project plans with timelines, deliverables, resource allocation, and milestones. Drive Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and release planning. Track project progress and remove execution bottlenecks. Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, and stakeholder expectations. Ensure predictable delivery with measurable outcomes. Monitor engineering velocity, sprint health, and delivery metrics. AI & Technical Leadership Partner with Engineering Managers, Architects, Product Managers, and Technical Leads to drive the successful execution of engineering initiatives. Develop a strong understanding of the product architecture, system design, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and software development lifecycle to effectively manage technical programs. Coordinate development across Backend, Frontend, Mobile, AI, Dev Ops, QA, Security, and Infrastructure teams. Facilitate technical discussions to identify dependencies, risks, implementation strategies, and delivery milestones. Work with engineering teams to estimate effort, prioritize technical debt, and balance feature development with platform stability. Ensure engineering best practices, coding standards, release processes, and quality benchmarks are followed across projects. Monitor technical progress, resolve cross-team blockers, and ensure alignment between engineering execution and business priorities. Support architecture reviews and design discussions by driving decision-making, documentation, and stakeholder alignment without being directly responsible for solution design. Coordinate product releases, production deployments, and post-release monitoring in collaboration with Engineering and Dev Ops teams. Stay informed about emerging technologies, AI trends, cloud platforms, and enterprise software practices to make informed program and product decisions, without requiring deep hands-on expertise. Cross-Functional Leadership Act as the central point of coordination between Product, Engineering, AI Research, Design, QA, Security, Dev Ops, Customer Success, Sales, and Leadership. Foster collaboration across distributed technical teams. Drive decision-making through structured discussions and data-backed insights. Facilitate executive reviews and program governance meetings. Customer & Business Engagement Engage with enterprise customers to understand business challenges and product requirements. Translate customer needs into scalable technical solutions. Participate in solution discussions, product demonstrations, and strategic customer meetings. Support pre-sales and post-sales teams during enterprise implementations. Execution & Delivery Excellence Ensure timely delivery of high-quality product releases. Define release plans and deployment strategies. Coordinate UAT, production rollout, and post-release monitoring. Drive continuous improvement in engineering processes. Establish measurable KPIs for product success and engineering efficiency. 0 2 requirements with enterprise clients. title: Executive Assistant/Admin
jobDescription: Apply via the Co Rover careers page. Requirements What We're Looking For Everything you need to know about this role — responsibilities and the skills we value. 0 1 Key Responsibilities Manage the Director's calendar, meetings, appointments, and daily schedules. Coordinate internal and external meetings, including preparing agendas, presentations, and meeting minutes. Handle professional email correspondence and follow-ups on behalf of the Director. Coordinate with various internal departments to ensure timely execution of assigned tasks. Arrange travel bookings, accommodation, transportation, and prepare travel itineraries. Maintain confidential documents, reports, presentations, and official records. Track action items and ensure timely completion by concerned stakeholders. Assist in preparing MIS reports, presentations, meeting notes, and business documents. Organize company events, leadership meetings, client visits, and official engagements. Handle office administration tasks, vendor coordination, procurement requests, and inventory management. Maintain proper documentation and filing of important business records. Support the Director in day-to-day operational and administrative activities. Perform internet research and compile relevant information whenever required. Ensure smooth communication between the Director and internal/external stakeholders. Manage confidential information with the highest level of professionalism and discretion. 0 2 Required Skills & Qualifications Master's degree in Management, or any relevant discipline. Freshers or candidates with up to 1 year of experience are encouraged to apply. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities. Good interpersonal and coordination skills. High level of professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality. Strong problem-solving and time-management skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Power Point, Outlook). Familiarity with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar). Basic knowledge of scheduling and productivity tools. Comfortable working with online collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or Google Meet. Good typing and documentation skills. 0 3 Preferred Skills Excellent presentation and documentation abilities. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to prioritize multiple tasks effectively. Professional email etiquette and business communication. Positive attitude with a willingness to learn. Self-motivated, dependable, and proactive approach towards work. What You'll Gain: Opportunity to work directly with the company's leadership. Exposure to strategic decision-making and business operations. Fast-paced learning environment in one of India's leading AI companies. Hands-on experience in executive management and corporate administration. Career growth opportunities in Executive Operations, Administration, HR, Program Management, or Business Operations. title: Principal Research Scientist - Advanced Foundations & Frontier Intelligence
location: Bengaluru, New Delhi, Mumbai - India; London - UK; Silicon Valley - US
jobDescription:
We are looking for a visionary Principal Research Scientist to lead core algorithmic breakthroughs at the absolute frontier of artificial intelligence. You will design next-generation foundation architectures, continuous learning systems, and multi-modal alignment protocols aimed at building scalable, personalized, and efficient intelligence. This role is for a premier researcher who wants to move AI beyond static, internet-trained models toward autonomous, adaptive, and resource-efficient systems. Requirements What We're Looking For Everything you need to know about this role — responsibilities and the skills we value. 0 1 Key Responsibilities Pioneer Next-Gen AI Foundations: Design architectures for emergent reasoning, long-horizon planning, and cognitive synthesis across distributed intelligence nodes Develop Continuous Persona Alignment: Build high-fidelity, real-time learning frameworks that capture human traits, speech patterns, and decision-making logic without catastrophic forgetting Human-Centric Conversational AI: Research dialogue systems that understand intent, emotion, and context for natural human-AI interaction Architect Agentic AI Systems: Formulate robust, secure AI-to-AI communication protocols for autonomous negotiation and workflow execution Standardized Agent Interfaces: Design MCP and API layers for each model to enable secure tool-use, function calling, and AI-to-AI communication Agentic Secure RAG: Build privacy-preserving retrieval systems using FHE, MPC, TEE for secure and sovereign memory Decentralized Data Sovereignty: Integrate cryptographic and federated learning mechanisms that maximize user data ownership Optimize for Edge & Resource-Constrained Hardware: Compile and compress multi-modal workloads for efficient execution on low-power devices. Focus on SLMs and optimized models Represent Co Rover: Serve as a technical ambassador for Co Rover at international tech/AI conferences and research forums. Build academic and industry partnerships IP Leadership: File full patents and contribute to the company’s IP portfolio. Translate research into defensible IP Research to Impact: Take research from concept to production at scale 0 2 Required Skills & Qualifications

EDUCATION:
Ph.D. Required in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a highly quantitative field from a premier institution Frontier Systems Focus: Proven research in foundation models, SLMs, multi-modal architectures, or personalized AI Agentic Frameworks: Deep expertise in lifelong learning, multi-agent coordination, and high-fidelity memory retrieval Human-Centric AI: Experience in conversational AI, persona modeling, and alignment Security & Privacy: Research background in privacy-preserving ML, secure RAG, FHE, MPC, or confidential computing Hands-on Execution: Highly hands-on in Py Torch/Tensor Flow/JAX. Capable of training and scaling models Publication Record: First-author publications in top-tier international research venues Patents: Should have patents. Preferably granted or filed in AI/ML 0 3 Preferred Skills SLMs & Optimization: Expertise in model compression, quantization INT4/INT8, Flash Attention, v LLM, Tensor RT-LLM, Tensor Flow Lite, XLA, JAX, Pathways, speculative decoding, edge inference Hardware Accelerators: Experience with NVIDIA GPUs, Google TPUs, and mobile/edge NPUs Energy Efficient AI: Research in reducing compute, memory, and energy for scalable deployment Conversational Video Pipelines: Real-time digital twins, talking-head generation, or video synthesis Distributed Systems: Deep Speed, FSDP, Ze RO, HPC, GPU clusters, Kubernetes Confidential Computing: Hardware security, differential privacy, decentralized protocols Research Leadership: Track record of presenting research at international forums 0 4 Why Join Co Rover AI with purpose and trust: Build technology that serves humanity Define the future of personalized and efficient AI from day 0 Work on fundamental research with global-scale impact Access state-of-the-art research compute Publish, patent, and present at leading research forums Generous ESOP for long-term alignment Mission: Build the ULM
